label: offset
environment_policy: remove all inherited environment variables whose names start with GC_; inherit all others; no CPU affinity or explicit heap cap
timing_boundary: heap_init and prepare_workload/layout descriptor setup are outside elapsed_seconds. The timer starts immediately before workload() and stops after it returns; workload includes the profile allocation/store/traversal/checksum computation and final major_collect(). The checksum assertion, stats formatting, getrusage(), and heap_destroy() are outside the timed interval.
schedule: eight cyclic rotations; each arm occupies each of four positions twice per profile
